create_rotation_from_quaternion: create a RotationObj from a quaternion tensor using from_quat function
create_rotation_from_matrix: create a RotationObj from a 3x3 rotation matrix tensor using from_matrix function
create_rotation_from_rotvec: create a RotationObj from a rotation vector tensor using from_rotvec function
create_identity_rotation: create an identity RotationObj representing zero rotation using the identity function
compose_rotations: compose two RotationObj instances using the multiply operator to stack rotations
